scope: All baseline trades with geometry features; exhaustive pairwise bucket combinations; chronological three-way split; maximum two features; no production rule changes

methodology.search: all unordered pairs across eight pre-declared geometry features and fixed research buckets
methodology.complexity: maximum two features; no continuous threshold search
methodology.split: first third DEV, second third VALIDATION, final third untouched HOLDOUT, chronological by entryTime
methodology.selectionGate: DEV and VALIDATION each n >= 8, PF >= 1, avgR > 0
methodology.holdout: Evaluated only after a candidate passes DEV+VALIDATION; never used for candidate ranking or selection
methodology.warning: Pairwise search has multiple-comparison risk. HOLDOUT results are the only untouched evidence in this run and must not be used to tune thresholds.

nextResearchQuestion: Freeze a small pre-specified set from DEV+VALIDATION, then report HOLDOUT robustness by BUY/SELL/session/day before any rule change.
